title: A Fully Polynomial Randomized Approximation Scheme for Perfect Matchings in General Graphs
summary: We give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS) for counting perfect matchings in arbitrary finite simple undirected graphs, resolving the general-graph perfect-matching approximation problem. The algorithm returns zero with certainty when no perfect matching exists. Otherwise, it achieves relative error ε with failure probability at most δ in worst-case bit time polynomial in the input length, $`\varepsilon ^{-1}`$, and $`\log\delta^{-1}`$.
family_title: Approximate counting and entropy of perfect matchings

review.reason: Gives an FPRAS for counting perfect matchings in arbitrary general graphs.
